    }

  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5046178980",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Drop the commit fixing MSVCRT regressions once #33593 merges and removes MSVCRT support",
      "quote": "renders the \"bitcoin: Fix msvcrt regressions from _execvp to _spawnvp switch\" commit unnecessary",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the MSVCRT workaround commit in push ad98271f after #33593 merged",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5296577726"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5714437254"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5296577726",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks dropped 68ae4a0f84b12587b9e2b53d3e306460fad4244a workaround."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3894313979",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "asks whether the runtime difference in error codes between MSVCRT and UCRT is documented elsewhere",
      "quote": "Checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/c-runtime-library/reference/spawnvp-wspawnvp?view=msvc-170 but this difference in error codes between runtimes is not documented there. Is it admitted els",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it was only observed in CI and added tests/comments; reviewer accepted in rc:3982725901",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3964034373",
        "rc:3970607586"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3982725901",
      "status_by_quote": "Impressive testing by @ryan8or. ^^ (https://github.com/ryanofsky/bitcoin/actions/runs/34367754505)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3982715149",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "asks why interface_gui.py is skipped on vcpkg builds instead of fixing QT_PLUGIN_PATH to make it run",
      "quote": "So why would you be changing the functional test to skip something which should be working?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that fixing bitcoin-qt execution is better handled in a separate PR and improved documentation in the meantime",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4087690228"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:3983276170"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4087690228",
      "status_by_quote": "I think this is probably better to address in a separate pr since this PR is supposed be a bitcoin.exe bugfix, not chang"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3998822372",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "MSVCRT builds report an unhelpful 'Invalid argument' error instead of 'No such file or directory' when the target executable is missing",
      "quote": "When the target executable is missing, the error the user sees differs between runtimes: MSVCRT: Error: execvp failed to execute '...\\bitcoind': Invalid argument",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer withdrew the concern in c:5714437254 after #33593 dropped MSVCRT support, and author dropped the workaround commit in r:5296577726",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5296577726",
        "rc:4087771863"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5714437254",
      "status_by_quote": "My own comment above about mapping EINVAL to ENOENT goes away with it, for the same reason."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5714437254",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "drop the MSVCRT workaround commit 68ae4a0f upon rebasing on #33593 while keeping generic errno handling commit 2b877984",
      "quote": "Suggestion for the rebase on #33593: drop 68ae4a0f, keep 2b877984. They read as one story, but only the first one is MSVCRT-specific.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed commit 68ae4a0f was dropped as suggested and provided a Tested ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5296577726"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5930586612",
      "status_by_quote": "68ae4a0f is dropped, as suggested earlier: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36105#issuecomment-5714437254"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4036513419",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Use prose attribution instead of Co-authored-by tags for AI assistance",
      "quote": "Otherwise, the co-author tags are only useful to you, but not really useful to anyone else.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to switch to prose attribution in future commits",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4087122052"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4087122052",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, added a regex to switch to prose attribution in future commits."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5046136756",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK.",
      "substantive": false,

      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": [
        "test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "nothing",

    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added cyb3ralbert's Tested ACK (c:5930586612), updated cyb3ralbert's stance to support, and marked suggestion c:5714437254 as accepted."
}
